name: Vaultwarden
description: Your own password manager, compatible with the official Bitwarden apps and browser extensions: passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, secure notes, file attachments and Sends, with shared vaults for family and team. Runs in your own account on a small instance with a 1 GB persistent disk, no separate database needed. Vaultwarden is open source (AGPL-3.0) and is not affiliated with Bitwarden, Inc.
